module: "Inspect a vehicle" marker in play mode (for example a vehicle to examine at a dealer): a floating icon (poi_parking_rect by default) linked to the ground by a line, which rises above the player's vehicle when it is within the radius. In the zone, the marker makes its POI interactive (the POI's data). A "focus" version stays visible from afar with a small bounce. The module returns {create, cluster}.
notes: cluster: one cluster per POI (no merging), id 'inspectVehicleMarker#<poi.id>', data = poi.data; reads poi.markerInfo.inspectVehicleMarker.{pos, radius, icon, focus}; visibilityRadius = 0.

Distances: the icon only appears within 60 m (farDist) when not in focus; it rises from 15 m (nearDist); in focus, the size decreases from 1 to 0.65 between 100 and 1000 m, the opacity drops to 0.35 below 750 m if the icon is hidden.
If the free camera is active, distances are measured from the camera, otherwise from the player's position.
The icon is hidden by static obstacles between the camera and the icon (castRayStatic).
isInAreaChanged is "in" or "out" for one frame when the inside/outside state changes.
The constants smallScaleDist/bigScaleDist/iconHeightBottom are used by update; the function distanceToHeight calls linearScale(dist, 15, 700, 1.0, 500).

create.desc: Builds a vehicle inspection marker (instance of C).

cluster.desc: Turns each inspectVehicleMarker POI into a distinct cluster and adds it to allClusters.

allClusters.desc: List of clusters completed in place.

C.desc: Vehicle inspection marker with animated icon.

init.desc: Assigns an id and creates the smoothers (position, cruising, opacity, distance); visible = true.

createObjects.desc: Cleans up existing objects (does not create any).

clearObjects.desc: Removes the icon from the icon renderer.

hide.desc: Becomes invisible and sets the icon opacity to 0.

setup.desc: Stores cluster, pos, radius, focus, resets the smoothers and creates the icon with initial opacity 0.

update.desc: Every frame: computes the distance, animates the icon's height (above the player's vehicle if it is inside), handles perspective in focus mode, adjusts size and opacity, draws the line to the ground (debugDrawer) and updates _inside and isInAreaChanged.

data.desc: Frame data: isFreeCam, camPos, camRot, playerPosition, highestBBPointZ, cruisingSpeedFactor, bigMapActive, dt.

interactInPlayMode.desc: If canInteract and the player is in the zone, adds cluster.data to the interactive elements.
